He played [[college basketball]] for the [[UMass Lowell River Hawks men's basketball|UMass Lowell River Hawks]]. ==Early life== Noel began his high school career at [[Saint John's Catholic Prep (Maryland)|Saint John's Catholic Prep]]. For his senior season, Noel transferred to [[Tuscarora High School (Maryland)|Tuscarora High School]], playing under coach Darryl Whiten.{{cite web |title=Seeking feedback, Tuscarora grad Noel tests NBA draft waters |url=https://www.usbasket.com/NBA/news/626636/basketball_1998-1999.aspx |website=USBasket |access-date=November 14, 2021 |date=April 24, 2020}} He scored 41 points in a game during his senior season. As a senior, Noel averaged 22.4 points, 5.2 rebounds and 3.5 assists per game.{{cite news |last1=Karim |first1=Allif |title="I'm very proud.." Tuscarora's Obadiah Noel closes in on his dream; as told by those around him |url=https://www.localdvm.com/sports/im-very-proud-tuscaroras-obadiah-noel-closes-in-on-his-dream-as-told-by-those-around-him/ |access-date=November 14, 2021 |work=WDVM |date=July 29, 2021}} He was named Frederick County Player of the Year.{{cite news |last1=Langone |first1=Matt |title=One offer was all UMass Lowell's Obadiah Noel needed |url=https://www.lowellsun.com/2021/01/31/one-offer-was-all-umass-lowells-obadiah-noel-needed/ |access-date=November 14, 2021 |work=[[Lowell Sun]] |date=January 31, 2021}} Noel committed to playing college basketball at [[UMass Lowell River Hawks men's basketball|UMass Lowell]], the only team to offer him a scholarship.{{cite news |last1=Langone |first1=Matt |title=UMass Lowell's Noel went from one college offer to NBA radar |url=https://www.lowellsun.com/2021/07/18/umass-lowells-noel-went-from-one-college-offer-to-nba-radar/ |access-date=November 14, 2021 |work=[[Lowell Sun]] |date=July 18, 2021}} ==College career== Noel averaged 6.5 points per game as a freshman off the bench. He was named to the [[America East Conference|America East]] All-Rookie Team. As a sophomore, Noel averaged 14.6 points, 3.5 rebounds, and 2 assists per game. Noel averaged 18.2 points, 5.2 rebounds and 2.7 assists per game as a junior, earning First Team All-America East honors. He declared for the [[2020 NBA draft]] but ultimately withdrew and returned to UMass Lowell.{{cite news |last1=Smith |first1=Joshua |title=Tuscarora grad Obadiah Noel announces he's headed for NBA draft |url=https://www.fredericknewspost.com/sports/level/collegiate/tuscarora-grad-obadiah-noel-announces-hes-headed-for-nba-draft/article_2d8a9742-c587-527a-89bf-27762cc34328.html |access-date=November 14, 2021 |work=[[Frederick News-Post]] |date=April 26, 2021}} On November 28, 2020, Noel scored a career-high 35 points in an 82–72 loss to [[Illinois State Redbirds men's basketball|Illinois State]].{{cite news |title=Strong carries Illinois St. past Mass.-Lowell 82–72 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401264408 |access-date=November 14, 2021 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 28, 2020}} He missed the final five games of the regular season with an undisclosed injury, but returned for the [[2021 America East men's basketball tournament|America East tournament]].{{cite news |last1=Langone |first1=Matt |title=Noel's bucket nets historic win for UMass Lowell |url=https://www.lowellsun.com/2021/02/27/noels-bucket-nets-historic-win-for-umass-lowell/ |access-date=November 14, 2021 |work=[[Lowell Sun]] |date=February 27, 2021}} As a senior, Noel averaged 21.4 points, 4.8 rebounds and 3.3 assists per game. He was named to the First Team All-America East. Noel became the second River Hawk to surpass 1,500 points during the Division 1 era. Following the season, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]], forgoing the additional season of eligibility granted by the NCAA due to the COVID-19 pandemic.{{cite news |last1=Langone |first1=Matt |title=UMass Lowell's Noel declares for NBA Draft |url=https://www.lowellsun.com/2021/04/26/umass-lowells-noel-declares-for-nba-draft/ |access-date=November 14, 2021 |work=[[Lowell Sun]] |date=April 26, 2021}} ==Professional career== Noel attended the Tampa Bay Pro Combine in preparation for the [[2021 NBA draft]]. He was named to the All-Combine team after averaging 14 points, 2.8 rebounds and 2.3 assists per game.{{cite news |last1=Smith |first1=Joshua |title=Tuscarora alum Obadiah Noel taking positive steps this summer in his NBA pursuit |url=https://www.fredericknewspost.com/sports/level/professional/tuscarora-alum-obadiah-noel-taking-positive-steps-this-summer-in-his-nba-pursuit/article_1eb338d3-ca71-5b19-8040-9096054212d3.html |access-date=November 14, 2021 |work=[[Frederick News-Post]] |date=July 7, 2021}} ===Raptors 905 (2021–2022)=== After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]], Noel joined [[Raptors 905]] in November 2021 after a successful tryout.{{cite news |last1=Murphy |first1=Blake |title=Raptors 905: 10 storylines to follow for 2021-22 G League season |url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/article/raptors-905-10-storylines-follow-2021-22-g-league-season/ |access-date=November 14, 2021 |work=Sportsnet.ca |date=November 5, 2021}} On January 6, 2022, he scored a career-high 28 points in a 103–94 win against the [[Fort Wayne Mad Ants]].{{cite web |last1=Quirante |first1=JD |title=Dial 905: Raptors 905 sweep Fort Wayne Mad Ants, plus the latest roster moves |url=https://www.raptorshq.com/2022/1/10/22876914/dial-905-toronto-raptors-905-fort-wayne-mad-ants-indiana-pacers-sweep-roster-moves |website=Raptors HQ |publisher=[[SB Nation]] |access-date=February 6, 2022 |date=January 6, 2022}} On December 12, 2022, Noel was waived.{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2022-23 NBA G League Transactions|date=December 12, 2022|access-date=December 12, 2022}} ===Westchester Knicks (2022–2024)=== On December 14, 2022, Noel signed a contract to join the [[Westchester Knicks]].{{cite web|title=2022-23 NBA G League Transactions|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=NBA.com|date=December 14, 2022|access-date=December 14, 2022}} On August 3, 2023, Noel signed with the [[New York Knicks]].{{cite web|title=Knicks Sign Obadiah Noel to Exhibit 10 Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/news/knicks-sign-obadiah-noel-to-exhibit-10-contract|website=NBA.com|date=August 3, 2023|access-date=August 6, 2023}} However, he was waived on September 6{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Knicks Waive Obadiah Noel|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2023/09/knicks-waive-obadiah-noel.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 6, 2023|access-date=September 6, 2023}} and on November 9, he was named to the [[Westchester Knicks]] opening night roster.{{cite web|title=Westchester Knicks Announce 2023-24 Official 19, 2024, Noel signed with [[APR BBC|APR]] of the [[Rwanda Basketball League]] and the [[Basketball Africa League]].{{cite web|first=Damas|last=Sikubwabo|title=Basketball: APR signs two G-League players ahead of BAL 2024|url=https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/16106/sports/basketball/basketball-apr-signs-two-g-league-players-ahead-of-bal-2024|website=NewTimes.co.rw|date=April 19, 2024|access-date=April 20, 2024}} Noel made his debut in the semi-final of the Genocide Memorial Tournament and scored 26 points, 7 rebounds and 3 assists against [[REG BBC|REG]].{{cite web|first=Damas|last=Sikubwabo|title=Star guard Noel proves why APR signed him ahead of BAL|url=https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/16169/sports/basketball/star-guard-noel-proves-why-apr-signed-him-ahead-of-bal|work=The New Times|date=April 22, 2024|access-date=April 23, 2024}} ===Indiana Mad Ants (2024–2025)=== On November 18, 2024, Noel was acquired by the [[Indiana Mad Ants]].{{cite web|title=Indiana Mad Ants Roster Updates|url=https://fortwayne.gleague.nba.com/news/indiana-mad-ants-roster-updates|website=NBA.com|date=November 18, 2024|access-date=November 18, 2024}} === Return to APR (2025–present) === On May 11, 2025, Noel returned to [[APR BBC|APR]] for a second stint in Rwanda, approximately one week ahead of the start of the [[2025 BAL season]].{{Cite web |last=Sikubwabo |first=Damas |date=2025-05-11 |title=Obadiah Noel returns to APR ahead of BAL 2025 |url=https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/26349/sports/basketball/obadiah-noel-returns-to-apr-ahead-of-bal-2025 |access-date=2025-05-13 |website=The New Times |language=en}} He helped the Lions finish in third place, the best results by a Rwandan team in league history.{{Cite web |title=APR clinch third place in the 2025 BAL in a record-breaking game |url=https://bal.nba.com/news/apr-clinch-third-place-in-the-2025-bal-in-a-record-breaking-game |access-date=2025-06-20 |website=The BAL |language=en}} Noel averaged 13.9 points and 3.2 assists per game,{{Cite web |title=Obadiah Noel Player Profile, Indiana Mad Ants - RealGM |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Obadiah-Noel/Summary/122189 |access-date=2025-06-20
